notes: This adapter-backed slice covers only publication eligibility for the standard HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject attribute at an already-known object class. Publishing an ordinary object attribute makes the standard privilege implicitly published; explicitly unpublishing the privilege blocks acquisition with AttributeNotPublished without changing ownership; explicitly publishing it then permits acquisition and Divestiture If Wanted. The scenario excludes inherited-class variants, subsequent publication epochs, other transfer forms, timestamped deletion, DDM, save/restore, interoperability, and conformance.

requirements.statement: At the object's known class, a joined acquirer cannot acquire HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject while that attribute is explicitly unpublished, but can acquire it after explicit publication; the test verifies the failed attempt leaves ownership unchanged and the successful transfer's callback and returned divested set.
